prerequisites.label: Skill 01 — Teach Yourself Protocol
prerequisites.satisfy: Complete Skill 01 (teach-yourself-protocol) before installing Skill 69. archify's INSTALL.md opens with the mandatory TYP check and must not be read or executed before TYP is confirmed.

prerequisites.label: Node.js runtime >= 18 (the skill's ONLY prerequisite — archify itself is zero-dependency)
prerequisites.satisfy: Install Node.js 18 or newer (package.json declares engines.node ">=18"). Verify with: node --version (expect v18.0.0 or higher). archify is a zero-dependency Node.js CLI — once node is present there is NO npm install, NO API key, NO credential and NO network step. There is nothing else to provision.
